itemListElement.name: Groq Free Tier — model-specific API limits
itemListElement.alternateName: Groq — حدود API مجانية تختلف حسب النموذج
itemListElement.description: Groq Free offers API access. Limits vary by model and apply at the organization level; the official table lists 1,000 requests and 200,000 tokens per day for some models.

itemListElement.name: Mistral Free Mode — limited monthly API access
itemListElement.alternateName: Mistral Free Mode — وصول API محدود بحصة شهرية
itemListElement.description: Mistral Free mode provides Studio and API access without a credit card, with limited monthly usage shared across Studio, API and Vibe. No dollar value for this allowance is published.

itemListElement.name: OpenRouter — free models with daily limits
itemListElement.alternateName: OpenRouter — حدود يومية للنماذج المجانية
itemListElement.description: Free models allow 50 requests per day and 20 per minute; the daily limit rises to 1,000 after at least $10 in total credits purchased. Failed requests count, and the free plan works without a payment method.

itemListElement.name: Google AI Studio — free Gemini 2.5 Flash
itemListElement.alternateName: Google AI Studio — Gemini 2.5 Flash مجاني بحدود معلنة
itemListElement.description: Gemini 2.5 Flash input and output are free in the Free Tier. Google Search grounding has a 500-request daily limit, not a general model request limit. Free-tier data may be used to improve Google products.

itemListElement.name: GitHub Copilot Free — 2,000 monthly completions
itemListElement.alternateName: GitHub Copilot Free — 2,000 إكمالًا شهريًا للأفراد
itemListElement.description: The free individual plan includes up to 2,000 code completions per month and a limited AI Credits allowance. It is separate from the existing Copilot Student offer.

itemListElement.name: Kaggle Notebooks — weekly GPU and TPU hours
itemListElement.alternateName: Kaggle Notebooks — ساعات GPU وTPU أسبوعية
itemListElement.description: Kaggle Notebooks provide up to 30 GPU and 20 TPU hours per week. Availability is limited and sessions may queue; a TPU session is limited to 9 hours.

itemListElement.name: Cohere — free Trial key for evaluation
itemListElement.alternateName: Cohere — مفتاح Trial مجاني للتقييم بحدود تختلف حسب الواجهة
itemListElement.description: Cohere provides a free Trial key for testing and proofs of concept. A 1,000-calls-per-month limit is documented for some Trial-key or endpoint cases; Trial keys are not for production or commercial use.

itemListElement.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free — compute and storage
itemListElement.alternateName: Oracle Cloud Always Free — موارد حوسبة وتخزين مجانية
itemListElement.description: Always Free resources include 2 OCPUs and 12GB Arm/Ampere A1 memory, up to two AMD Micro instances, 200GB Block Volume and 10TB monthly outbound data. Card verification is required; idle instances may be reclaimed under stated thresholds.

itemListElement.name: Google Cloud — $300 for 90 days
itemListElement.alternateName: Google Cloud — رصيد 300 دولار لمدة 90 يومًا
itemListElement.description: Eligible new users receive $300 for 90 days plus selected Free Tier services. A payment method is required; covered usage is not charged before upgrade. Resources stop at trial end, with a 30-day recovery period.

itemListElement.name: AWS Free Plan — $100 plus up to $100 more
itemListElement.alternateName: AWS — 100 دولار عند التسجيل وحتى 100 إضافية
itemListElement.description: The new plan gives $100 at signup and up to $100 more through eligible activities, for up to six months on selected services. Most new customers do not need a payment method, with exceptions; the plan closes when time or credit runs out.

itemListElement.name: Azure — $200 for 30 days (Iraq eligible)
itemListElement.alternateName: Azure — 200 دولار لمدة 30 يومًا (العراق مؤهل)
itemListElement.description: The offer is available in Iraq: $200 for 30 days plus selected free services for 12 months. A phone number and non-prepaid payment method are required; free-tier services are not charged before manual upgrade.

itemListElement.name: DigitalOcean — up to $200 for 60 days
itemListElement.alternateName: DigitalOcean — حتى 200 دولار لمدة 60 يومًا
itemListElement.description: The MLH offer provides up to $200 for 60 days to eligible new customers. A valid credit card is required; overages and active resources are billed after the trial ends.

itemListElement.name: Cloudflare Free — DNS, CDN, SSL and Workers
itemListElement.alternateName: Cloudflare Free — DNS وCDN وSSL وWorkers
itemListElement.description: Cloudflare Free is $0/month and includes DNS, CDN and Universal SSL. Workers Free allows 100,000 requests daily. R2 has a monthly free allowance but requires subscription and billing setup.

itemListElement.name: Backblaze B2 — first 10GB free
itemListElement.alternateName: Backblaze B2 — أول 10GB تخزين مجانية
itemListElement.description: Backblaze B2 includes the first 10GB of storage free, with egress up to 3x average monthly storage and an S3-compatible API. No credit card is required to get started.

itemListElement.name: eu.org — free subdomain with human review
itemListElement.alternateName: eu.org — نطاق فرعي مجاني بمراجعة بشرية
itemListElement.description: eu.org offers free subdomain registration. Applications require human review that may take a few days; its policy welcomes non-European sites. Registration duration and card requirements are not specified.

itemListElement.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack — partner offers
itemListElement.alternateName: GitHub Student Developer Pack — عروض للطلاب المتحققين
itemListElement.description: GitHub Education's Student Developer Pack combines GitHub and partner offers for verified students; terms vary. A university email is not universally required. New Copilot Student signups were paused in April 2026 without a reopening date.

itemListElement.name: Azure for Students — $100 for 12 months
itemListElement.alternateName: Azure for Students — رصيد 100 دولار لمدة 12 شهرًا بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: Eligible students receive $100 to use within 12 months with no credit card required. Eligibility requires age 18+, full-time study at an accredited degree-granting institution and institution-email verification; Iraq-specific availability is unconfirmed.

itemListElement.name: Notion Education — free Plus for one-member workspaces
itemListElement.alternateName: Notion Education — Plus مجاني لمساحة فردية للطلاب والمعلمين
itemListElement.description: Notion offers Education/Plus free for one-member student and educator workspaces at accredited colleges and universities listed in WHED. A primary school email and annual verification are required.

itemListElement.name: CodeRabbit — free PR reviews for public repositories
itemListElement.alternateName: CodeRabbit — مراجعات PR مجانية للمستودعات العامة
itemListElement.description: CodeRabbit states that PR reviews are free for public repositories and eligible open-source projects. Private-repository features have separate plans and are not covered by this offer.

itemListElement.name: PostHog — 1M events and 5,000 recordings monthly
itemListElement.alternateName: PostHog — مليون حدث و5,000 تسجيل جلسة مجانًا شهريًا
itemListElement.description: The free plan includes 1 million analytics events and 5,000 session recordings per month, with no credit card required. At free limits usage stops or excess events are dropped; the allowance resets monthly.

itemListElement.name: MongoDB Atlas M0 — 512MB free
itemListElement.alternateName: MongoDB Atlas M0 — 512MB مجانية بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: Atlas Free/M0 provides 512MB at no cost and requires no credit card. A cluster pauses after 30 days of inactivity with zero connections and can be resumed.

itemListElement.name: Viktor — up to $100 starting credit
itemListElement.alternateName: Viktor — حتى 100 دولار رصيد بدء بلا بطاقة ولا انتهاء
itemListElement.description: Viktor's free plan starts with up to $100 in credits; no credit card is required and free credits never expire. Viktor is an AI employee in Slack and Microsoft Teams.
